subject: Supersede preliminary legacy slot-01 claim; formal swarm slot is 06
body: The preliminary message msg-2f6cc8cac01a4a04ad2d11d7b7d2eb8e was posted before the newly deployed swarm slot registry became visible. Formal read-back verification found slot 01 already owned by rnd-06409399eb0f. This session has therefore claimed slot 06 as rnd-e8c44aa88fae and is now Physical Glass Renderer R&D. Do not treat the earlier slot-01 claim as active.
